summary: Rationale and feasibility assessment of registered secondary hypotheses H002 (cheap_negative) and H003 (absolute_extreme) against existing extended data, without preregistering new tests from grid hits or relaxing gates.

hypotheses.claim: Extremely cheap negative basis predicts elevated forward downside tail risk; kept distinct from rich-positive basis.
hypotheses.rationale: Negative basis (perpetual below spot) may reflect funding stress/short squeeze exhaustion or forced deleveraging; distinct mechanism from rich-positive basis. Already represented as a registered orientation in the frozen grid (cheap_negative).
hypotheses.feasibility_against_existing_data: Data available: extended dataset has 5010 rows / 336 missing_label exclusions and covers all 324 grid cells including cheap_negative cells (324 ok in extended ledger). No new data or new experiment ID required to test; however any test must be a preregistered hypothesis with new experiment ID and independent rationale, not selected from grid hits.
hypotheses.blockers_to_testing: No preregistered experiment beyond H001; must not select anchor/parameters from inspected grid results (holdout/multiplicity). Requires new experiment ID + predeclared rationale + new anchor/config.

hypotheses.claim: Extreme absolute basis magnitude predicts elevated forward downside tail risk regardless of sign; not merged with directional tests.
hypotheses.rationale: Magnitude of basis dislocation (either direction) may proxy market stress/liquidity dislocation; orientation already in frozen grid (absolute_extreme).
hypotheses.feasibility_against_existing_data: Same extended dataset and grid coverage as H002; absolute_extreme cells present in extended ledger (324 ok). No new data required.
hypotheses.blockers_to_testing: Same as H002: no preregistration; must not derive parameters from grid hits; needs new experiment ID + independent predeclared rationale + new anchor/config.
